title: PHOTOS: Winning keiki create 'paw'-some art for a cause - NewsBreak
text:
By Carley Matsumura ,
1 days ago
HONOLULU (KHON2) — Keiki went ‘paws’-on for an annual art contest held by the Hawaiian Humane Society! The winners of the 2026 Mission PAWsible contest were announced on Tuesday, April 14.
“These students channeled their inner Picassos and created meaningful art that was both educational and impactful to pet lovers of all ages, representing the budding generation of animal welfare in Hawaiʻi,” said Anne Mukai, Manager of Education Programs at the Hawaiian Humane Society.
Oʻahu students from sixth grade to 12th were tasked with highlighting “the importance of veterinary care through diverse artistic mediums”. These mediums included creative writing, digital art, traditional art and 3D art.
“This year’s Mission PAWsible entries highlighted the talent and creativity of local keiki and their ability to make a difference for pets everywhere, not just in the shelter,” Mukai said.
Winning students Hawaiian Humane Society listed the following winners for each category:
Creative writing
Sixth to eighth grade winner: Zoe, Mālama Honua Public Charter School Ninth to 12th grade winner: Caleb, ʻAiea High School Honorable mention, ninth to 12th grade : Melanie, Punahou School Grades 6-8, Creative Writing Winner Zoe from Mālama Honua Public Charter School. (Courtesy: Hawaiian Humane Society) Digital art
Sixth to eighth grade winner: Amaya, Ewa Makai Middle Ninth to 12th grade winner: Ahina, Punahou School Honorable mention, sixth to eighth grade: Luella, Kaimukī Middle School Grades 6-8, Digital Art Winner
Amaya from ʻEwa Makai Middle School. (Courtesy: Hawaiian Humane Society) Traditional art
Sixth to eighth grade winner: Hailey, Ewa Makai Middle School Ninth to 12th grade winner: Aleigha, Pacific Buddhist Academy Honorable mention, sixth to eighth grade: Sienna, Highlands Intermediate School Grades 6-8, Traditional Art Winner Hailey from ʻEwa Makai Middle School. (Courtesy: Hawaiian Humane Society) 3D art
Sixth to eighth grade winner: Milla, La Pietra Academy Ninth to 12th grade winner: Sophia, Hawaiʻi Baptist Academy Honorable mention, ninth to 12th grade: Danielle, Hawaiʻi Technology Academy Grades 6-8, 3D Art Winner Milla from La Pietra Hawaiʻi School for Girls. (Courtesy: Hawaiian Humane Society) Prizes Two grand prize winners and one honorable mention were selected from each category by a panel of judges.
The entries were judged according to the contest theme, creativity, clarity, visual quality and other submission regulations.
Each winner will receive the following:
$100 Visa debit gift card Humane Achievement Award Hawaiian Humane merch Personal campus tour with their family For more information on the contest, visit Hawaiian Humane’s website .
